row.notes: Renamed from Career_ResourcePoints_SetUnlockFlag_ActiveTeams: the entries are keyed by a packed driver key and matched against driver records, not teams. Whole body read. Walks every used slot of the hash set (slots [+0x40], control words [+0x48], count [+0x50]); for each entry writes flag to byte +8, unpacks the u16 key (id low 14 bits, type top 2 bits) and, unless the id is 0x3fff, finds the driver record in list [*wallets+0x2e0..+0x2e8] (0x88 stride, short +0x52, byte +0x50); when the record has byte +0x81 == 0 or byte +0x80 < 2 it posts a bus message (vtable 0x1458504c0, packed key) with Ne_Post_BusMessage. Caller Career_ResourcePoints_OnUnlockFlagMessage calls it on rp+0x4b8 in per-driver mode (rp+0x4b0 == 0) with flag = (msg byte +0x10 == 5). (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
